$comment: Missing-info class routing by ROLE. People hold roles in registry/people.json; never put people in these rules. Twin: registry/missing-info-routing.md

architecture.departmentRoles: REGISTERED in registry/people.json with source + asOf

support_websites.name: #support-websites
support_websites.use: Public intake and overflow; staff, packets, copy, visual QA

admin_websites.name: #admin-websites
admin_websites.use: Private; events sync and urgent reliability

hubspot_n8n_gdm.name: HubSpot/n8n GDM with website-operations
hubspot_n8n_gdm.use: Sync exceptions, wordpress_post_id, overwrite handling with n8n-sync-owner and website-operations

staff_photo_title_bio.when: Meet our Team add/update blocked on headshot, bio, quote, title, page URL, or keep/remove
staff_photo_title_bio.resolutionNote: Requester first; dean-of-parents is LIVE via Admissions Hub. Not events or n8n-sync-owner.

launch_copy_coming_soon.when: Coming Soon or Fall launch overlays on open campuses; Missing Info on status or replacement hero media
launch_copy_coming_soon.resolutionNote: Campus requester confirms; website-operations executes once confirmed.

hubspot_campus_facts.when: Grades, address, phone, tuition, admissions email, or Book a Call disagree with HubSpot, or WP hand-edits would be overwritten
hubspot_campus_facts.resolutionNote: Director of Admissions (live) confirms fact; hubspot-owner edits HubSpot Program; n8n-sync-owner runs sync. Do not hand-edit synced WordPress facts.

events_public_sync.when: Public=Yes missing or wrong on site, or canceled event still live
events_public_sync.resolutionNote: events (content / Public flag) then events sync partners (hubspot-admin / events holders who own HubSpot to site reliability). Channel #admin-websites. Do not file Website APEX.

info_packet.when: Packet CTA 404, Flipsnack, calendar page, or unapproved campus packet
info_packet.resolutionNote: Campus supplies facts; marketing-collateral designs Canva; brand-authority signs off; expansion-founding language QA; website-operations hosts public packet links when approved. packet-owner person is an open gap (see responsibilities gaps).
info_packet.gap: packet-owner person unclear; Dmitry was incorrectly sole holder

apply_link_admission.when: APPLY TODAY or application campus map wrong, or admission_link empty
apply_link_admission.resolutionNote: hubspot-owner confirms admission_link and admissions email; website-agent-operator maps WP CTA once SoT URL exists.

brand_copy_voice_ux.when: Brand, voice, or UX wording undecided
brand_copy_voice_ux.resolutionNote: brand-authority is SoT; brand-authority-liaison relays UX feedback. website-agent-operator / website-operations implement.

n8n_overwrite_or_sync_exception.when: Sync overwrites WP; new campus needs wordpress_post_id; custom Serving/IF nodes; Locations List automation
n8n_overwrite_or_sync_exception.resolutionNote: n8n-sync-owner primary; website-operations partners in HubSpot/n8n GDM. New locations: HubSpot wordpress_post_id = -1 then run sync.
doNot: just edit WordPress for synced fields

admissions_team_leadership.when: Who owns admissions website or Alpha High expansion asks after historical Amelia Baldwin requester
admissions_team_leadership.resolutionNote: expansion-founding. Amelia Baldwin is historical only; do not assign.

requester_waiting_escalation.when: Wait, SLA, or backlog risk; not missing campus facts
requester_waiting_escalation.resolutionNote: No escalation role exists (Matt Barge, 2026-09-15). Backlog and waiting complaints go to the website operators themselves; they answer on the ticket.
doNot: clear Missing Info by inventing answers

operatorChecklist: Classify Missing Info using the classes above.
Prefer requester for one-off assets; HubSpot Program for campus facts; events then sync partners for Public=Yes; n8n-sync-owner for overwrite exceptions.
Resolve people from registry/people.json (department) or the live campus resolver (campus roles).
Comment APEX with who was asked and what is still needed.
Never invent emails or Slack IDs.

ticketClassMap.$comment: spec/ticket-classes.json class -> routing class above. Routing classes with no ticket class (n8n_overwrite_or_sync_exception, admissions_team_leadership, requester_waiting_escalation) are reached from the note on the ticket, not from classification.
ticketClassMap.$unmapped: observer-layout, observer-health, other-workflow route by spec/responsibilities.json registryByTicketClass alone
